name: Hobble Creek Event Center
description: An event center on Hobble Creek Golf Course in Springville with mountain and canyon views, an indoor reception room and patio, and weddings year-round; in-house catering is available from the Sand Trap Café.

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Premier decor package: up to 100 sparklers, bubbles or light wands

Decor > Ceremony arch / backdrop.wording: Ceremony Backdrop with One Floral Spray

Decor > Greenery / florals.wording: Ceremony Back Drop with Two Faux Floral Spray's

Decor > Signs / easels.wording: Wedding signs, guest sign, card box etc

Decor > Chandeliers.wording: Two Floral Chandeliers or Two Crystal Chandeliers

items.label: Description
items.value: An event center on Hobble Creek Golf Course in Springville with mountain and canyon views, an indoor reception room and patio, and weddings year-round; in-house catering is available from the Sand Trap Café.

items.label: Address
items.value: Hobble Creek Golf Course, Springville, UT

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Weekday rental (Mon-Thu), 6 hours 4pm-10pm (up to 96 crossback chairs, 12 tables, 12 linens, color of choice, cake table, gift table, table and chair setup, AV system) — $1,500
Same inclusions — weekday 12 hours — $2,500
Same inclusions — weekend (Fri-Sun) 6 hours 4pm-10pm — $2,000
Same inclusions — weekend 12 hours — $3,000
Classic Decor package — $350
Premier decor package — $500

items.label: Deposit
items.value: Date is secured only once a deposit is received (amount not stated)

items.label: Rule
items.value: No ceremonies on the golf course

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Up to 96 crossback chairs
12 tables
12 linens, color of choice
Cake table
Gift table
Table and chair setup
Bistro lights

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value: Venue team provides coordination, setup and planning support

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Couple handles setup and takedown within the rental time
Sand Trap Café handles setup, service and cleanup of its own catering

items.label: Ceremony arch / backdrop
items.value: Ceremony Backdrop with One Floral Spray

items.label: Greenery / florals
items.value: Ceremony Back Drop with Two Faux Floral Spray's

items.label: Signs / easels
items.value: Wedding signs, guest sign, card box etc

items.label: Chandeliers
items.value: Two Floral Chandeliers or Two Crystal Chandeliers

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Classic Decor package (8-10 simple centerpieces, ceremony backdrop with one floral spray, 8-10 table runners, wedding signs and card box; setup and takedown) — $350
Premier decor package (8-10 centerpieces, 8-10 table runners, cake knife set, send-off set for up to 100 with sparklers, bubbles or light wands, two floral or crystal chandeliers, ceremony backdrop with two faux floral sprays, signage, custom entry sign; setup and takedown) — $500

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Golf-course setting with mountain and canyon views
In-house catering available from the Sand Trap Café
3D virtual tour on the website

items.label: Classic Decor
items.value: Price: $350 · Includes: 8-10 simple custom curated centerpieces; ceremony backdrop with one floral spray; 8-10 table runners; wedding signs, guest sign, card box; setup and takedown

items.label: Premier package
items.value: Price: $500 · Includes: 8-10 custom curated centerpieces; 8-10 table runners; cake knife set; send-off set for up to 100 (sparklers, bubbles or light wands); two floral or two crystal chandeliers; ceremony backdrop with two faux floral sprays; wedding signage; custom wedding entry sign; setup and takedown

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Outside catering permitted; outside caterers have no access to the Sand Trap Café kitchen
In-house catering partner: Sand Trap Café (10% gratuity on custom catering)
Favorite caterers listed: Brown Brothers, Marvelous, Magleby's

items.label: Alcohol
items.value: A licensed and insured professional bartender must be hired to serve all alcohol

items.label: Terms
items.value: 10% gratuity on custom catering; 1 meal choice under 30 people, 2 over 30; one flavored beverage and water included; prices subject to change

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Premier decor package: up to 100 sparklers, bubbles or light wands

items.label: Sparklers
items.value: Yes (sparklers are a send-off option in the Premier decor package)

items.label: Times
items.value:
Weekday (Mon-Thu) 4pm-10pm, or 12-hour rental
Weekend (Fri-Sun) 4pm-10pm, or 12-hour rental
Times can be adjusted

items.label: Rental length
items.value: 6 hours or 12 hours; rental time must include setup and takedown

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No ceremonies on the golf course; use off-site rented areas such as Kelly's Grove or Jolley's Ranch
Couple photos on the golf course only with a staff member
Rental time must include setup and takedown
Outside caterers may not use the Sand Trap Café kitchen

items.label: Parking
items.value: More parking is available later in the day

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Rental rates and decor packages are published as images linked from the Services page; prices are listed as 'starting from'
Rental includes up to 96 crossback chairs; no guest capacity is stated
